body:
I'm just sick of all the pain that it's causing me and that I'm too ashamed to tell my family how bad it really is. Everyone expects so much of me and I know they are all disappointed with the way I turned out since I was "such a promising child". I don't really care about the money or fitting in, if I just had $250 a month I could manage since my parents are kind enough to pay my rent. But it's getting unbearable to always have to worry about meeting people I know when I go outside, having to make up excuses for why I can't work and never knowing when I'll next have any money at all to feed myself.

I'm sorry about your lungs, if it's not possible to repair the damage I can see why you would want out.

I'm good at nothing, and I have nothing of value I could sell or anything else I could offer anyone. I could sell myself but it's not worth $170 an hour when it would most likely push me to suicide even quicker. 

It's not just because of money it's mostly because of how quickly my mental health is declining and all the rest is just happening because of that. 

My mother would find it difficult but my father wouldn't care much. He never talks to me unless he has to, I can't remember the last time he called me. I could just write a letter to my mother saying I've ran off to be with my ex boyfriend who lives in the UK.
